title: Session: CI/CD and published container deployment
objective: Validate version 2.8.0 through PR checks and post-merge GHCR publication, then confirm that the bot can be deployed from published images with its existing database and Discord configuration.
user: Review the CI/CD PR after CI result is green. Merging it to main triggers publication of the bot and sidecar images.
After first publication, make both GHCR packages public or authenticate deployment hosts for package read access.
Pull the published images with the DevBot Compose overlay and recreate the services. Keep the isolated tarubot_dev database.
Run `/version`, `/config validate`, and `/sync status`. Confirm version 2.8.0, available configured resources, and no unexpected blocked work.
Report the results. The lobby/officer-channel security implementation is the next feature; this release adds delivery automation.
assistant: Verify full tests with both the supplied local dump and generated synthetic CI input; validate workflow and Compose definitions.
Open the feature PR and inspect all required CI checks; verify published tags and platforms after merge.
Record results, preserve the source-build development path, and resume the agreed lobby/security work.
bot: Run compiled application code from the selected container image and report its installed SemVer.
Retain links, grants, nicknames, ledger history, and queued work in PostgreSQL across container replacement.
Reconcile current roles and resume durable work after startup; expose capability and delivery status.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in the configured development channel.
